summary: Bound iOS collections WebSocket handshakes, retain native failure codes, and keep Share sheet connections alive

compatibility.detail: The collections client retains its existing queued-command and onOpen contract. Native socket failures include only NSError domain and code; generic socket errors remain supported.

downtime.detail: No service restart required; the native error metadata requires an updated iOS build.

manual.detail: No manual action required. Transient inactive states preserve the previous foreground state; background still suspends the feed until active.

recovery.detail: Revert this change to restore the previous opening deadline and inactive-state behavior.
